name: Tienda Deportiva Uy
description: Sports retailer in Montevideo with an online store on WooCommerce. Sells fitness, swimming, cycling, football, camping and orthopedic products, and electric mobility. States delivery across Uruguay to the home; shipping costs and times are not stated on the homepage.
description_es: Comercio deportivo de Montevideo con tienda online en WooCommerce. Vende productos de fitness, natación, ciclismo, fútbol, camping, ortopedia y movilidad eléctrica. Indica entrega a domicilio en todo el país; los costos y plazos de envío no figuran en la página principal.

ships_to.notes: Homepage states shipping to the whole country and delivery to the home. Costs and times not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a Montevideo store address; in-store pickup is not stated.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping, categories and store address
